text:
Monique Anderson (Founder at IT’S RATED BY 👉🏽 Creator Marketing Expert + Marketing Strategist ⚡️Talent Manager)
4 x nominations for our agency at this years bCreator™ ?! are you KIDDING ME 🥹 ( yes, real tears were shed) 

Our talent management arm is only 18 months old, so award nominations like this hit differently. This is HUGE recognition for us at IT'S RATED BY, and for one of those four nominations being mine, as Talent Manager of the Year?  🙌🏾💛

This is also my first post of the YEAR on LinkedIn (in June 😬 )…but this news felt important enough to break my  6-month LinkedIn hiatus (I’ll be talking about that break at some point & why I took it !). 

As a boutique agency, everything is such a TEAM effort , we speak to our creators daily, strategise their content with them and build their careers meticulously. When Venus G. shared the news with our talent, there wasn’t a dry eye on either side of the phone 🥲

👉🏽Thank you Alice Audley  and Jamie Edwards for your hard work curating this needed space for our industry. Amazing to see  ITV as the headline sponsors again  Sylvia Brendel  Ben Webster ( I remember when this sponsorship was being considered, and it’s only grown from strength to strength!)  👏🏽

👉🏽 Congrats to all of those nominated in any capacity! Great to see some of my fave business creators on the shorlist Charlotte Mair  & Mia McGrath   💛

‼️You can vote here: https://lnkd.in/esnaqAHc 

Oh and hey LinkedIn! It’s great to be back 💛
